items.headline: Beach Hazards Statement issued September 27 at 8:03PM PDT until September 28 at 5:00AM PDT by NWS San Diego CA
items.description:
* WHAT...Minor coastal flooding expected due to the combination
of high tides and elevated surf.

* WHERE...San Diego County Coastal Areas and Orange County
Coastal Areas.

* WHEN...For the Beach Hazards Statement, through 5 AM Monday.
For the Coastal Flood Advisory, from 5 AM Monday to 5 PM PDT
Wednesday.

* IMPACTS...Minor coastal flooding and minor coastal erosion
expected during high tides. Additionally, elevated surf will
lead to strong rip currents.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Elevated surf of 3-5 feet expected. Local
sets to 6 feet possible on south-facing beaches. Morning high
tides are expected to peak between 6.8 and 7.1 feet through
Wednesday, highest on Tuesday morning. The listed tide
predictions have been corrected to reflect current trends in
actual tide observations.
items.instruction:
If travel is required, allow extra time as some roads may be
closed. Do not drive around barricades or through water of
unknown depth. Take the necessary actions to protect flood-prone
property.

Stay off of rock walls and jetties. Remain out of the water to
avoid hazardous swimming conditions. If you do swim, always swim
near a lifeguard.

Avoid beaches during morning high tides.
